name: Rarat
source:
The mascot character from a popular anime, which has spawned several merchandising, like stuffed plushies.

[url=https://vndb.org/c21104]Orikura Manami[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c77361]Miki[/url] from the First Kiss Story series can be seen having Rarat toys.

[spoiler]Rarat is a an actual familiar in the world of Natsuiro Celebration, existing both in fiction and reality. It gives [url=https://vndb.org/c77974]Ousaki Maho[/url] her magical girl powers and serves as her companion.
